SESSION	SET spark.sql.ansi.enabled = false
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 INT NOT NULL) USING PARQUET
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION AS SELECT * FROM t
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 BIGINT NOT NULL) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES (1)
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 STRING NOT NULL, c2 INT) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES ('1', 2)
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES ('a', 2)
READ	SELECT * FROM v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 MAP<STRING, STRING>, c2 INT) USING PARQUET
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 INT, c2 INT) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 2)
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v AS SELECT * FROM t
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 INT NOT NULL) USING PARQUET
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c3 INT NOT NULL, c2 INT) USING PARQUET
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 INT) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES(1)
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v WITH SCHEMA BINDING AS SELECT * FROM t
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 STRING) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES('1')
READ	SELECT * FROM v
DDL	ALTER VIEW v WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
READ	SELECT * FROM v
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
